mods.title: Rebirth & Vodel Bots Overhaul.
mods.description:
Improved aiming, accuracy, and faster reactions.

Smarter combat, targeting, and enemy tracking.

Aggressive movement, sprinting, and tactical sprinting.

Bots chase enemies inside buildings and on rooftops.

Custom operator skins, mastery camos, and meta loadouts.

Randomized plane jumps and landing locations.

Full armor and automatic armor regeneration.

Downed system with self-revive.

Customizable bot redeployment chance.

Smart teleporting and water rescue.

Balanced player and bot damage.

Optimized shooting system to reduce server lag.

In-game settings menu to customize difficulty, combat, movement, and survival.
